company.name: Restaurant365
company.shortDescription: Restaurant365 is an enterprise management software for restaurants that provides accounting, inventory, scheduling, and payroll solutions.
company.description: Restaurant365 is a restaurant enterprise management software that provides accounting, inventory, scheduling, payroll, and HR solutions. Restaurant365 provides a restaurant-specific accounting and back-office software platform that reduces the significant burdens placed on restaurant operators, allowing concepts to operate more efficiently and profitably in the digital age. It is a cloud-based, all-inclusive back office solution that combines key restaurant modules with an integrated accounting backbone.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Private Equity round raised $175,000,000, or 40% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $106,199,422 to $1,789,357,456, a 16.85x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 86 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 43 (-18).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
